text:
incident-bot: Pager — P1 billing/metering anomaly detected in eu1: token_count drift vs baseline. Overflagging threshold crossed for multiple customers. Auto-runbook kicked: /runbooks/metering-token-drift

emily: Oncall emily — grabbing. What services are showing symptoms?

kevin: emitter-streamer + billing-collector. Seeing delayed emits from kafka consumer group emitter-consumer-eu1, offsets lagging ~00:18. Sample log: 
```
2026-03-20T02:12:03Z emitter-consumer[14] WARN commit failed: OffsetCommitTimeout
2026-03-20T02:12:03Z emitter-consumer[14] INFO rebalancing, paused processing
```

sara: CS: a handful of customers have active overage flags & billing emails triggered (internal list: cid-1023, cid-2044, cid-7710). They're low-volume but flagged incorrectly. Customers are reaching out.

emily: @kevin can you check if this is replay/dup or undercount? Also @matt can you confirm ingestion pipeline health?

kevin: quick check — counts are drifting upward (duplicate emission) while ledger ingest is delayed, so reconciliation isn't catching duplicates yet. Suspect consumer retries combined with delayed ACKs. I can roll a hotfix to tighten commit retry logic.

matt: infra side — I see a spike in consumer CPU on shard 14 and multiple GC pauses around 02:11Z. Kafka broker 3 shows ISR shrink during the window. Might be transient broker flakiness causing the consumer group to rebalance repeatedly.

emily: Mitigation plan: 1) Pause shadow backfill and any heavy reconciles to stop amplifying counts. 2) Toggle feature flag to prevent auto-backfill: `redwood-ffctl set emit-shadow false --env eu1` 3) Scale up emitter-consumer replicas temporarily. 4) Kick reconciliation in incremental mode once lag < 1m.

kevin: Running command to pause backfill now: `./bin/emitterctl --env eu1 pause-backfill --reason "live drift"`

ops-bot: Deploy started: rolling restart emitter-consumer (replicas=6 -> 9) by matt. Link: https://ci.redwood/deploy/9876

kevin: Hotfix pushed to emitter consumer to reduce commit retries and add idempotency guard. Rolling restart in progress. sha: a1b2c3d

cs-lead: Noted. CS will send one consolidated message to affected customers after ops confirms stabilization. Hold any credit decisions until we know extent.

emily: Short-term customer impact: overflag emails sent to 7 customers, 3 of which are likely false positives. We're prepping a rollback email and manual crediting workflow if needed.

kevin: Observability now: token delta vs baseline has decreased from +4.2M to +800k in 9 minutes since mitigation started. Kafka offsets returning to normal.

emily: Running incremental reconcile: `recon-cli run --env eu1 --mode incremental --window 02:00-03:00Z --batch 1000` — will capture duplicates and mark them for debit/credit. ETA first pass 25m.

matt: Infra note: bumped broker disk watermark and set broker 3 maintenance window. No immediate disk pressure but I/O latency was cause of rebalances.

kevin: Logs showing the commit-timeout exception root cause. Patch prevents double-emit on consumer restart. Will monitor.

emily: Action items summary (short):
- emily: coordinate CS comms and billing hold
- kevin: monitor hotfix and reconcile output, escalate if delta not improving in 15m
- matt: keep infra watch on broker 3 and report back when ISR stable
- cs-lead: prepare customer message draft + manual credit checklist

sara: CS draft ready, will post to #customer-notify once emily says stable.

emily: 30m update: lag reduced to ~90s, overflagging rate down ~75%. Reconcile first-pass detected ~1.2M duplicate tokens; marking 1.2M to reverse in billing. Leaving thread open until full reconciliation completes and credits are issued. Will update in 30m or on any regressions. :white_check_mark:
